full_judgment: 3. The relevant facts necessary for the disposal of both the civil appeals are that on 12.07.1993 the respondents No.1-2 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.155 of 1993 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Sylhet impleading the appellant as main defendant and respondents No.3-9 as proforma defendants praying for declaration of title over the 2nd schedule land and for recovery of Khas possession of the said land upon removing the houses and obstruction there from.
